stopRule: One attempt per frozen formal cell. Continue other cells after failure; retain failed and incomplete cells, do not retry noise or deadline misses. A correctness or source/binary identity failure stops the remaining formal matrix. Five independent Player processes per scene, all four balanced blocks in each process. No global cache clearing or power/driver changes.
inputIdentity: Canonical r9700-query-v1-seed51ed270b positions, payload XOR process seed; r9700-index-update-v1 motion. Sparse static; hotspot change1/cross1; streaming change5/cross20 plus actual bundle timeline. Seeds vary payload, not spatial distribution.
cachePolicy: Natural OS/driver caches, no forced cold cache. Fresh buffers/indices per arm. Four balanced arm positions per process; first-use and setup retained separately.
statistics: For each metric, calculate each block/arm arithmetic mean and p50/p95/p99 over the predeclared 320 steady frames; retain 384-frame and whole-process summaries too. Paired baseline/candidate ratios within blocks, geometric mean of four block ratios per process, then Student t interval on five process log ratios (df4). CV uses five process arithmetic means for both arms; drift is maximum absolute baseline last-block/first-block mean change across processes. p95 ratio uses paired block p95s, geometric mean across blocks and processes. A metric passes only with all five complete equal-work processes, mean-ratio 95% CI lower bound >1, both CV<=5%, drift<=15%, and p95 ratio>=1.01. No correlated frame is an independent repeat; no pooling scenes or promoting defaults. Comparisons are descriptive, unadjusted for multiplicity; no universal winner claim.
engineAlignment: Windows QPC source timestamps, equal recorded clock frequency and overlapping epoch required. Map engine frameStartTimestamp to earliest recorded Update QPC >= timestamp; use that Update's Unity frame. Reject duplicate mappings. Keep missing or zero metrics unavailable; per-arm engine comparisons require >=95% positive matched frames in every block. Never assign by observedUnityFrame. Last eight process frames drain engine timing only.
scope: Native sceneGpu includes clear,index,query+frameDigest,history,particles,overlay on main D3D12 queue; it is not full engine GPU. Full engine GPU/main/render CPU come only from aligned FrameTimingManager. Engine cadence is coroutine frame interval, never OS display cadence. OS presentation unavailable. First screen is engine first EOF since Unity startup, not process-launch-to-display. CPU recording includes fixture motion, changed-frame full uploads, real content work; cached active count updated on actual lifecycle changes and independently oracle-checked.
tailCaveat: p99 has about 3.2 samples per steady block and lifecycle registration only twice per arm; report counts and all outliers, no confirmed rare-tail claim. Setup, teardown, serialization and process intervals remain in raw evidence and full-process summaries.
